title: Preparation and enzyme activity of recombinant protein
author: Ning Zhang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zf7f3rn
materials: ligate CTSL sequence with pET28a vector.
Keep the supernatant in 15ml conical tubes

steps.title: Inoculate and Culture Bacteria
steps.instruction: Inoculate 1ml of overnight culture into 100ml of 2xYT media in a 500 ml flask.

steps.title: Induce Protein Expression
steps.instruction: Incubate the culture in a 37°C shaker until the OD600 reaches 0.6 (approximately 3.5 hours), then add 100ul of 100 mM IPTG and incubate for an additional 3 hours.

steps.title: Harvest and Resuspend Bacteria
steps.instruction: Pellet the bacteria and resuspend them in PBS with protease inhibitors.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 6,000 rpm for 5-6 minutes to pellet bacteria.
Resuspend the pellet in 9ml PBS containing protease inhibitors.
Transfer the suspension to 50 ml conical tubes.

steps.title: Sonicate Bacterial Suspension
steps.instruction: Sonicate the bacterial suspension on ice using the specified power settings.

substeps.instruction: Perform 4 cycles of 1 minute sonication with 30 second rests.
Set power settings to: cup, 10; tip, 5.

steps.title: Detergent Treatment
steps.instruction: Incubate the sonicate with Triton X-100 to further lyse cells.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sonicate to a 10-15 ml conical tube.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C on a rocker.

steps.title: Clarify Lysates
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysates to remove cell debris and unlysed bacteria.

substeps.instruction: Transfer lysates to high-speed tubes (e.g., 12-14ml falcon tubes from BD or VWR).

steps.title: Bind Protein to His Beads
steps.instruction: Incubate the supernatant with His beads to capture the recombinant protein.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature (RT) with constant rocking.

steps.title: Collect and Wash Beads
steps.instruction: Isolate the beads and remove unbound proteins through washing.

substeps.instruction: Pellet the beads at 2,000 rpm for 2 minutes at 4°C.
Wash the beads 3 times with PBS, 5 minutes each at RT with rocking.

steps.title: Final Resuspension and Storage
steps.instruction: Resuspend the purified protein beads and store them.
